name: Shri Naveen Jindal
education:
B.Com. (Hons.), MBA
 University of Delhi; University of Texas,Dallas, U.S.A.
other_profession: Philanthropist and Social Worker, Pilot, SPORTSPERSON
present_address: Bungalow No. 12, New Moti Bagh, New Delhi, 110021
permanent_address: House No.1, Jindal House Mohan Nagar, Kurukshetra kurukshetra Haryana, 136118
social_activities: Single handed fought for the dignified display of the National-Flag as a symbol of honour and pride including display of the tri-colour on clothes; Zealous about ushering honesty into public life and eradicating corruption, unemployment and poverty; worked for the ban of smoking in the Central Hall of Parliament House; worked for the development of Kurukshetra and for the development of sports in the country; Instrumental (i) in getting permission for flying the National flags on monumental flagpoles over 100 ft high during night hours too; and (ii) amending Rule 349 (XIV) of the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha allowing Hon. Members to wear the National Flag in the form of lapel pin/badge.
interests: Promoting respectful display of National Flag which symbolises national honour and pride; bringing honesty into public life and eradicating corruption and red tapism; achieving population stabilization through education for all especially women
hobbies: Playing polo, horse riding, shooting, reading, walking, exercise and yoga
sports: Former National Champion and present National record holder in skeet shooting; won silver medal in SAF games,Pakistan, 2004; Gold at the Open Shooting Championship, Singapore, 2004; Captain of Jindal Steel & Power Polo team; winner of Indian Open 2003 and 2004, an event of highest level of polo played in India; President, Equestrian Association of Chhattisgarh; Two silver Medals at the 48th National Shooting Championship, Indore 2004; Silver medal at the 50th National Shooting Championship, New Delhi, December 2006; Gold Medal at the V Sardar Sajjan Singh Sethi Memorial Master Shooting Competition, Jaipur 2007

literary_activities: Pioneered the manufacture of the world`s longest rail (121 meters long); installed beam blank caster and H-beam (Universal) rolling mill first time in India for providing large sized parallel of large beams; manufacture of widest plates in the form of coils and established the country`s first eco-friendly Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) plant
